spanish: Y mandará el sacerdote, y tomará al que se purifica dos pájaros vivos, puros, y madera de erez y carmesí y ezov.

findings.issue: Common noun אֶרֶז is left untranslated as erez; a non-name lemma must be Spanish.
Construct שְׁנִי plus absolute תוֹלַעַת is collapsed into carmesí, so the worm noun is omitted.
Common noun אֵזֹב is left untranslated as ezov; a non-name lemma must be Spanish.
לַ marks the hithpael participle as the one for whom the items are taken; tomará al can be read as taking that person.

notes: Priest, weqatal 3ms, two living clean birds, and the item list order match the tokens.
